Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.4: Mass

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mass, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How can we measure large amounts of mass?
